name: WP CV Builder
author: Best WP Developer

sections.description:
WP CV Builder is a WordPress CV builder and resume builder for creating a self-service resume website, career portal, or CV SaaS platform. Users can register, build and manage multiple CVs from the front end, while administrators control templates, subscriptions, employers, jobs, applications, reviews, emails, and downloads.

The plugin combines a Gutenberg resume builder with responsive CV templates, WooCommerce payments, a searchable job board, employer tools, multilingual support, and mobile-friendly dashboards.

CV and Resume Builder Features

  • 25 responsive CV templates with matching editor, preview, and PDF layouts.
  • Front-end CV editor so registered users can create resumes without entering the WordPress dashboard.
  • Gutenberg CV Builder block with editable profile, experience, education, skills, languages, references, hobbies, social links, signature, and custom sections.
  • Multiple CVs per account with saved versions, restore actions, and download history.
  • PDF resume export with A4 sizing, multi-page protection, transparent signatures, and stable typography.
  • Template gallery shortcode with Free/Pro labels and selected-template registration handoff.
  • Multilingual and RTL support for Arabic and other right-to-left or translated resume content.
  • Mobile-responsive editor and dashboard for creating and managing CVs on phones, tablets, and desktops.
  • Secure CV share links with protected tokens and social-sharing actions.

Job Board and Employer Portal

  • Publish a searchable WordPress job board with a Gutenberg block or shortcode.
  • Let candidates view job details and apply with a saved CV using no-reload AJAX actions.
  • Show a persistent Applied state and prevent duplicate job applications.
  • Allow employer registration, front-end job posting, job editing, recoverable deletion, and applicant CV previews.
  • Configure free or paid employer access and optional administrator approval for submitted jobs.
  • Generate job-description drafts with an administrator-configured OpenRouter model.

WooCommerce CV Subscriptions and Services

  • Create Pay Per CV, monthly, yearly, and other CV subscription plans.
  • Open enabled WooCommerce payment gateways inside focused, responsive checkout dialogs.
  • Sell professional CV review services and return the completed CV to the customer dashboard.
  • Enable or disable automatic completion for WP CV Builder orders, including Cash on Delivery test orders.
  • Send renewal and expiry reminders and show the customer’s current subscription state.
  • Design branded registration, CV-ready, employer, application, review, password, and expiry emails.

What Is New in Version 1.7.12?

  • Restored accurate Style 1-25 template mapping across selection, editing, preview, and download.
  • Improved template typography, social icons, skill bars, language percentages, QR sizing, signatures, and long translated headings.
  • Added a protected front-end editor, unified customer workspace, employer portal, job board, applications, CV reviews, and version history.
  • Added OpenRouter API settings with selectable text models for supported AI writing tools.
  • Added secure share tokens, safer permissions, owner checks, nonce protection, and escaped rich-text output.
  • Improved embedded WooCommerce checkout, paid-access validation, download tracking, and optional order auto-completion.
  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.0.

WP CV Builder Pro

WP CV Builder Pro extends the free CV builder with:

  • 8 additional ATS-friendly resume templates.
  • Live ATS and Europass readiness scoring while the CV is edited.
  • Existing CV import for supported PDF, DOCX, text, JSON, and LinkedIn export files.
  • AI-assisted About Me, cover letter, and resume-content workflows through OpenRouter.
  • Additional export, template-control, monetization, and white-label options.

Compare plans and view the current Special Deal

External Services

WP CV Builder can use the following optional external services. These services are contacted only when the related feature is configured or used.

  • OpenRouter: When an administrator saves an OpenRouter API key and a user requests AI writing, the selected model ID and relevant prompt content are sent to OpenRouter. See the OpenRouter Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
  • Google Fonts: A selected Google font may be loaded from Google Fonts in the visitor’s browser. See the Google Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
  • YouTube privacy-enhanced embeds: If the administrator adds a YouTube tutorial URL, the video is embedded from youtube-nocookie.com. See the YouTube Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.

Payment processing is provided by the WooCommerce gateways enabled by the site administrator. Each gateway has its own terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “WP CV Builder”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  5. Navigate to WP CV Builder > Settings to configure templates, pages, payments, and email options

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the cv-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate WP CV Builder and WooCommerce through the Plugins menu
  4. Open WP CV Builder > Settings and assign the required pages
  5. Add the CV Builder block or a supplied shortcode to the relevant front-end page
sections.faq:
What is WP CV Builder SaaS, and how does it work?

WP CV Builder turns WordPress into a front-end CV and resume platform. Users register, create and manage CVs, choose templates, export resumes, apply for jobs, and access paid features according to the plans configured by the administrator.

Do I need coding or design skills?

No. Administrators configure the plugin from WordPress settings, while CV users and employers work from responsive front-end dashboards.

Can I use this on multiple websites?

The free plugin follows the GPL license. Pro activation and support limits depend on the license purchased from the WP CV Builder website.

What payment options are supported?

WP CV Builder uses enabled WooCommerce payment gateways. This can include PayPal, Stripe, Cash on Delivery, and other compatible gateways installed by the site administrator.

What’s included with my purchase?

The free plugin includes the core CV builder, 25 templates, front-end workspace, job-board tools, and WooCommerce-ready workflows. Pro plans add ATS templates, scoring, import, AI assistance, and advanced business features. Check the pricing page for the current license details.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WP CV Builder uses WooCommerce products, orders, and payment gateways for subscriptions, employer access, and paid CV review services.

Does the plugin support RTL languages?

Yes. The editor and templates include RTL-aware layouts for Arabic and other right-to-left languages. Translation files for multiple languages are also included.
